description: Build a complete invoice as structured data: invoice number, issue and due dates, line items, discount, tax, total and payment terms. Nothing is stored. Use when the user wants an invoice for a client. Do NOT use for totals only (use calculate_totals) or for a printable text version (use render_invoice_text).

business_name.description: Name of the business or freelancer issuing the invoice, e.g. "Acme Design Studio"

client_name.description: Name of the client being billed, e.g. "Globex Corp"

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, case-insensitive: one of USD, EUR, INR, GBP, AED, SGD, AUD, CAD. Default USD.

discount_pct.description: Discount in percent of the subtotal, 0-100, e.g. 10 for 10% off. Default 0.

due_in_days.description: Payment term in days from today; sets due_date and 'Net N' terms. Default 14.

invoice_number.description: Invoice number to use, e.g. "INV-2026-042". If omitted, one is generated as INV-YYYYMMDD-NNNN.

items.description: Line items (at least one), each {description, quantity, unit_price}; line amount = quantity x unit_price.

description.description: What was sold or done, e.g. "Logo design" or "Consulting hours"

quantity.description: Quantity or hours, must be > 0, e.g. 10

unit_price.description: Price per unit in the invoice currency, >= 0, e.g. 50

notes.description: Free-text notes printed on the invoice, e.g. payment instructions. Default empty.

tax_rate_pct.description: Tax rate in percent, 0-100, applied after the discount, e.g. 18 for 18% GST. Default 0.

name: create_invoice

date.description: Issue date, today in UTC, YYYY-MM-DD.

items.description: Line items echoed back as provided.

description.description: What was sold or done, e.g. "Logo design" or "Consulting hours"

quantity.description: Quantity or hours, must be > 0, e.g. 10

unit_price.description: Price per unit in the invoice currency, >= 0, e.g. 50

subtotal.description: Sum of quantity x unit_price, rounded to 2 dp.

symbol.description: Currency symbol used when rendering, e.g. $.

tax_rate_pct.description: Tax rate percent that was applied.

title: Create invoice
